sloka: स च ता दयिता भग्नाः कन्याः परम शोभनाः ।दृष्ट्वा दीनाः तदा राजा संभ्रांत इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-३२-२५॥
transliteration: sa ca tā dayitā bhagnāḥ kanyāḥ parama śobhanāḥ ।dṛṣṭvā dīnāḥ tadā rājā saṁbhrāṁta idam abravīt ॥1-32-25॥

translations.english: The king saw his extremely beautiful beloved daughters distressed and shattered and spoke these words with bewilderment.
